name: Aurora Capture Module
description: A compact camera module for capturing bright planets and lunar craters through a small telescope. It includes a USB-C connection, an adjustable gain control, and a lightweight mounting sleeve.

name: Horizon Travel Scope
description: A 50 mm refractor built for travel and solar observation. The kit includes a glass solar filter, a 20 mm eyepiece, a compact tripod, and a padded carry bag.

name: Ridgeview 8x42 Binoculars
description: A rugged roof-prism binocular for birds, trails, and wide-field sky scanning. The 8x magnification and 42 mm objective give a bright, stable view in low light.

name: Starfinder 70 Refractor
description: A beginner-friendly 70 mm refractor with a smartphone mount and a red-dot finder. The included app helps you locate bright stars, planets, and the Moon.

name: SunShield Solar Filter
description: A full-aperture solar filter for 8-inch telescopes. The aluminum cell and glass film are designed for safe visual observation of the Sun.

name: Deep Field Optical Tube
description: A fast 8-inch imaging tube for wide-field astrophotography. The dual-speed focuser and cooled mirror cell are built for long exposures.

name: The Night Watcher's Almanac
description: A pocket guide to the seasonal sky, with star charts, observing notes, and a short history of the constellations.

name: Optics Care Kit
description: A cleaning kit for lenses, filters, and camera sensors. Includes a blower, brush, microfiber cloths, and a bottle of lens cleaning fluid.

name: NightTrail Red Lamp
description: A red-light headlamp with a dimmable beam, a magnetic mount, and a USB-C rechargeable battery. Designed to preserve night vision.

name: TrailScope 60 Travel Refractor
description: A compact 60 mm refractor for travel and backyard observing. The kit includes a tripod, two eyepieces, and a carry case.
